title: Daily 5, Fri 20 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: A pipe fills a tank in 8 hours. A leak at the bottom can empty the full tank in 24 hours. With the leak present, how many hours does the pipe take to fill the empty tank?
What is the maximum value of 12x − x² for real x?
A is 40% more than B. If A is 210, find B.
The average of three numbers is 20. Two of them are 15 and 18. Find the third number.
Find the compound interest on ₹10,000 for 1 year at 10% per annum, compounded half-yearly (in ₹).
